meta.name: pm-skill-creator
meta.description: Design a new PM skill through guided conversation. Use when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话将想法转化为合规技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有原始内容或想法，想把它塑造成一个合规的技能。
copy.tagline_en: Turn raw ideas into compliant skills through guided conversation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

howto.what: Claude会引导你走过完整的PM技能设计流程:从原始想法或内容出发,通过最多5个自适应问题确定技能类型(组件/交互/工作流)、范围、结构和内容,最终生成一份符合仓库规范的SKILL.md草稿。
howto.when: 当你手头有原始内容或想法,想把它变成合规的PM技能时触发。比如你提供了一份笔记、一个框架,或直接说“帮我设计一个新技能”,Claude就会开始引导式提问。

say.text: 我有一份定价框架,帮我把它设计成技能。
say.note: Claude会先确认这是框架还是其他类型,再开始提问。

say.text: 帮我把这份决策树笔记整理成一个SKILL.md草稿。
say.note: Claude会分析笔记内容,并提议技能结构。

say.text: 我想创建一个新技能,主题是用户故事编写。
say.note: Claude会询问技能类型和范围。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through skill-design: from raw idea/content, asks up to 5 adaptive questions to determine type, scope, structure, content, then generates complete SKILL.md draft with required sections and repo-compliant frontmatter.
howto.when_en: Use when you have raw content or an idea to shape into a compliant skill. Triggered by notes, a framework, or asking for a new skill; Claude starts a guided conversation with up to 5 questions.

say_en.text: I have a pricing framework — help me turn it into a skill.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the type and start asking questions.

say_en.text: Turn these decision-tree notes into a SKILL.md draft.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the notes and proposes a structure.

say_en.text: Help me create a new skill on writing user stories.
say_en.note: Claude asks about scope and naming.
